info.title: Prelude
info.author: Nextendo Network
info.description: Switch your console between Nextendo Network and Nintendo
info.details:
Prelude is the homebrew that switches your console between the Nextendo Network community servers and Nintendo's official servers.

Pick a mode, Prelude applies the change and reboots. Nothing is permanent: Nintendo mode removes everything Prelude installed and hands the console back to Nintendo, with Atmosphere's own telemetry blocking restored.

- Nextendo mode: redirects Nintendo traffic to the Nextendo servers and installs what the console needs to trust them
- Online setup for supported games, with the right hosts and patches
- Follows the console's system theme, with a language list of English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Chinese, Russian and Italian
- Self-updating from GitHub releases

Needs a console running Atmosphere (CFW). Prelude changes Atmosphere's hosts files and installs patches on the SD card, so back up your SD card first. More information at https://nextendo.network

changelog: 4.0.15: Russian and Italian translations, with Montserrat for Cyrillic text; Guilty Gear -Strive- service hosts; safer "Reinstall patches" (each resource is checked before it replaces the installed one, and an offer to reboot after a manual reinstall).
